description: Add admin role support: IsAdmin on User, AdminOnly policy, role claim in sign-in, seeder update, and EF migration. Also add Order/OrderItem/OrderStatus models, CheckoutViewModel, DbSets, and second EF migration. These two migrations must be authored together because FEAT-002 depends on both being applied before it can build.
steps: 1. Edit Models/User.cs: add `public bool IsAdmin { get; set; }` property with default false. No annotation needed — EF will map it as a non-nullable BIT column.

2. Edit Data/DbSeeder.cs: in the Users block, after creating the demo user set `demo.IsAdmin = false`. Then add a second seeded user: admin@scooters.bg / Admin123!, FullName='Администратор', IsAdmin=true. Use the same PasswordHasher<User> pattern already in the file. Guard with `if (!context.Users.Any(u => u.Email == "admin@scooters.bg"))` so re-seeding is safe.

3. Edit Controllers/AccountController.cs: in the private `SignInUser` method, after the existing claims list, add `if (user.IsAdmin) claims.Add(new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, "Admin"));`. No other changes to this method.
4. Edit Program.cs: in `builder.Services.AddAuthorization()`, change it to `builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options => { options.AddPolicy("AdminOnly", policy => policy.RequireRole("Admin")); });`.
5. Create Models/OrderStatus.cs: `namespace Scooters.Models { public enum OrderStatus { Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled } }`.

6. Create Models/Order.cs: Id Guid (key), UserId Guid, User navigation property, CreatedAt DateTime (default DateTime.UtcNow), Status OrderStatus, FullName/Phone/Address/City strings ([Required][MaxLength(200/30/300/100)]), Total decimal, Items List<OrderItem> = new(). Use `namespace Scooters.Models`.

7. Create Models/OrderItem.cs: Id Guid (key), OrderId Guid, Order navigation property, ProductId Guid, ProductName string ([Required][MaxLength(100)]), UnitPrice decimal, Quantity int, computed `public decimal Subtotal => UnitPrice * Quantity;` (not mapped). Use `namespace Scooters.Models`.

8. Create Models/CheckoutViewModel.cs: FullName/Phone/Address/City all [Required] strings with display names in Bulgarian, Items List<CartItem> = new(), Total decimal. Add `using Scooters.Models;` and `namespace Scooters.Models`.

9. Edit Data/AppDbContext.cs: add `public DbSet<Order> Orders { get; set; } = null!;` and `public DbSet<OrderItem> OrderItems { get; set; } = null!;`. In OnModelCreating, configure Order→User FK (DeleteBehavior.Restrict), Order→Items cascade, and mark OrderItem.Subtotal as `[NotMapped]` via Fluent or [NotMapped] attribute on the property.
10. Run `dotnet ef migrations add AddIsAdminToUser --project c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters` to generate the migration for IsAdmin on User.
11. Run `dotnet ef migrations add AddOrders --project c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters` to generate the migration for Orders and OrderItems tables.
12. Run `dotnet build c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters\Scooters.csproj` and confirm Build succeeded.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations/AddIsAdminToUser migration file exists and adds IsAdmin column to Users table
Migrations/AddOrders migration file exists and creates Orders and OrderItems tables
OrderStatus enum has 5 values: Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled
Order and OrderItem models compile with required navigation properties
CheckoutViewModel compiles with all 4 required string fields and Items/Total
Program.cs registers AdminOnly policy requiring Role=Admin
AccountController.SignInUser adds Role=Admin claim when user.IsAdmin is true
verification: Confirm output contains 'Build succeeded' with 0 errors
